title: Manhattan Marvel & Science Adventure
summary: A 2-day trip for a father and 12-year-old son who love Marvel, Spider-Man, Knicks, science, and Percy Jackson. Day 1 focuses on Midtown landmarks and science museums near Central Park, while Day 2 explores downtown areas with family-friendly attractions and halal food options.

tips: Purchase museum tickets online in advance to skip lines
Use the subway for efficient travel between Midtown and Downtown areas
Check prayer times daily as they shift slightly each day
Bring snacks and water for the kids during museum visits
